
# Sales Data Model

## Table: SALES

### Primary Key
- OrderID

### Columns

| Column Name | Description |
|---|---|
| OrderID | Unique Order ID |
| OrderDate | Sales Order Date |
| City | Customer City |
| Category | Product Category |
| Product | Product Name |
| Quantity | Sales Quantity |
| UnitPrice | Product Unit Price |
| SalesAmount | Total Sales Amount |

## Relationships
No relationships defined.

## Data Model Purpose
This ERD defines the structure of the Sales
data model used for Qlik application generation.
